title: Bits and shifts
description:
Write these functions, without `imul`, `mul` or `div`:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `is_odd(x)` | 1 if x is odd, else 0 (`and` with 1) |
| `set_bit(x, n)` | x with bit n set; n from 0 to 63 (the count must be in `cl`) |
| `times10(x)` | x × 10, with `lea` and/or shifts |
| `div8(x)` | a signed x ÷ 8 rounded **down**, with one shift: `div8(-9)` is −2 |
| `byte_of(x, k)` | byte k of x, k from 0 to 7: `byte_of(0x1122334455667788, 1)` is 0x77 |
| `swap_nibbles(x)` | the low byte of x with its two hex digits swapped: `swap_nibbles(0xAB)` is 0xBA |

starter.solution.asm:
is_odd:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

set_bit:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

times10:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

div8:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

byte_of:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

swap_nibbles:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
is_odd:
        mov     rax, rdi
        and     eax, 1
        ret

set_bit:
        mov     ecx, esi
        mov     eax, 1
        shl     rax, cl
        or      rax, rdi
        ret

times10:
        lea     rax, [rdi + rdi*4]      ; x * 5
        add     rax, rax                ; * 2
        ret

div8:
        mov     rax, rdi
        sar     rax, 3
        ret

byte_of:
        lea     ecx, [rsi*8]            ; the bit position: k * 8
        mov     rax, rdi
        shr     rax, cl
        and     eax, 0xFF
        ret

swap_nibbles:
        mov     eax, edi
        and     eax, 0x0F
        shl     eax, 4                  ; the low digit moves up
        mov     ecx, edi
        shr     ecx, 4
        and     ecx, 0x0F               ; the high digit moves down
        or      eax, ecx
        ret

rules: Use shifts, masks and lea instead of multiplying or dividing.
Use sar for the signed division.
unitTests:
test "odd or even"
    is_odd(7) == 1
    is_odd(10) == 0
    is_odd(-3) == 1
test "setting a bit"
    set_bit(0, 0) == 1
    set_bit(0, 4) == 16
    set_bit(1, 63) == 0x8000000000000001
    set_bit(16, 4) == 16
test "times ten"
    times10(7) == 70
    times10(-12) == -120
    times10(123456789) == 1234567890
test "a signed shift"
    div8(64) == 8
    div8(15) == 1
    div8(-16) == -2
    div8(-9) == -2
test "picking bytes"
    byte_of(0x1122334455667788, 0) == 0x88
    byte_of(0x1122334455667788, 1) == 0x77
    byte_of(0x1122334455667788, 7) == 0x11
test "swapping nibbles"
    swap_nibbles(0xAB) == 0xBA
    swap_nibbles(0x0F) == 0xF0
    swap_nibbles(0x1234) == 0x43
